summary:
CONSOLIDATED REVIEW — Visual Themes Pipeline Complete

This review consolidates the 5 pending gates (afterBackend, afterFrontend, afterQA x3) into a single summary. The visual themes feature is fully built, applied, and QA-passed.

**What shipped:**
- 6 visual themes (Default, Warm, Cool, Neon, Pastel, Minimal) × light/dark variants
- CSS custom property system with design tokens
- ThemePicker, AccentColorPicker, DarkModeToggle components
- AG Grid variable mapping for consistent table styling
- Socket.IO real-time theme sync across collaborators
- Export compatibility (themes render correctly in PNG export)
- Full keyboard navigation and ARIA labels

**Key decisions:**
- CSS custom properties over theme provider (simpler, no JS runtime cost)
- 6 curated themes rather than fully custom (opinionated > infinitely configurable)
- Theme stored per-roadmap, not per-user (collaborative consistency)

**QA verdict:** PASS. Enzo verified all 3 views (timeline, board, swimlane), dark/light toggle, theme persistence, real-time sync, and export. No regressions.

**Code:** 18 files, 373 insertions applied to /home/jeff/forge-app. TypeScript build passes clean.

**Next:** Alice starting command palette frontend (RT-38c) immediately. ETA 2-2.5 days.

RECOMMENDED: Approve this review to formally close the visual themes pipeline and unblock command palette.
